name: gate_bookend_critic
verdict: PASS — MUST_FIX = 0 on both bookends after three blinded critique rounds and a targeted confirmation pass.

headline_defects: Introduction asserted a universal 'nothing disputes that the somatostatin signal falls' that the body contradicts in HD striatum and one PD CSF series; scoped to Alzheimer cortex
a 2.7-fold calcium-event value attached to Algamal2022b when the body assigns it to Algamal2022a, which the Introduction may not cite; deleted rather than re-sourced
Conclusion attributed the Sst-knockout x App knock-in refutation to the receptor arm when it is negative on the enzyme
three caption/image disagreements including four tiers captioned against five rendered, and two named rows that do not exist

new_defects_12: Gabriel1993 made to carry both sides of a two-paper dispute
independent cross-laboratory replication asserted for Iaccarino2016+Martorell2019, one programme
figure legend describing open squares as a second status when four rows carry open squares only
the replicated marker attributed to a single mega-analysis

new_defects: panel A rigor ordering became non-monotone as a second-order consequence of the authorised re-order
'the same drug' attributed levetiracetam to Verret2012, a genetic Nav1.1-restoration experiment

rounds.scope: the three changed loci plus a full caption/code/notebook/image check of the regenerated figure; the full-section sweep was round 3 on the immediately preceding version, and the coordinator independently verified the final text in code

coordinator_adjudications.ruling: The two evidence packages disagreed (mouse cerebral cortex vs rat primary auditory cortex). Resolved against the paper's CrossRef title, 'Trajectory of the main GABAergic interneuron populations from early development to old age in the rat primary auditory cortex'. Section 01's package was wrong and was corrected (version 0bb03d8a); the attribution was restored in the prose rather than left deleted.

Not unsourceable. Traced verbatim to the section 07 package for the same DOI and written into the section 01 package. Values kept, the missing unit (cells) added, and the two distinct P values kept apart.

Reviewer OVERRULED. The range is verbatim in the paper's own figure legend, recorded as the source sentence for the same key in the section 04 package; the paper's running text gives a 25% floor, so the discrepancy is internal to the paper. No manuscript change.

The 77/77 full-text share is certified in the review's own evidence base, verified by the round-1 critic against all ten per-cluster pairs. The writer was told to frame it as the review's coverage metadata rather than delete a true value.
